I am old now, 74 years, but my hands still know the soil. I went to primary school only, but 54 years on this land taught me more than books. My 5 mu is not big, not small. Just me and my wife at home now, children moved to city.

I do wheat-maize like everyone here in Quzhou. Cotton I plant a little on the side, maybe 1 mu, because the price has been not so good but I am used to growing it. Wheat 2 mu, maize 2 mu, that is my plan, same as last year. Why change? Last year wheat gave me about 450 kg per mu, maize close to 550 kg. Not bad for old man.

For wheat I buy improved seed from the dealer in town, everyone does. I put about 2 bags of compound fertilizer (NPK) before planting, that is around 25 kg N per mu, plus urea topdressing in spring, another 10 kg N. Phosphorus maybe 8 kg, potassium 5 kg, comes in the compound. I water 3 times — before winter, jointing, and grain filling. My well still works, thanks god.

Maize after wheat harvest, no time to plough deep, I do rotary only and direct seed. Hybrid seed, I trust the Zhengdan type, neighbors get good results. Fertilizer about 18 kg N at planting, then 12 kg urea at big trumpet stage. Water 2 times if rain is short. Spray pesticide 2 times for borer and aphid.

Cotton I plant 1 mu, plough it properly, more fertilizer because cotton eats a lot — about 15 kg N, and I spray maybe 5-6 times for bollworm, cannot avoid. Yield maybe 250 kg seed cotton.

Better put a bit more fertilizer than too little. Bad harvest is disaster, extra bag of urea is just 100 yuan.
